reason: The 1,000-unit controlled cell completed, then the 10,000-unit cell raised MemoryError inside identity.assign_one_to_one / LogicalIdentityResolver.score_pair while semantic diff attempted all-pairs identity matching. No final receipt was written. The failure is a real scalability limitation of the full change-detection path in this harness, not evidence that selective recompilation itself failed equivalence.

partial_1000_observation.interpretation: At 1k in this hash-build harness, semantic identity/diff/planning overhead made the selective end-to-end path roughly 487x slower than the trivial full hash rebuild; this is a negative result and is not hidden.
partial_1000_observation.interpretation_build_only: When diff/planning were excluded, rebuilding only selected artifacts was 3.60x faster in the 1k harness. This partial number is exploratory because the preregistered 10k cell did not complete.

scientific_response: Preserve the failure. Separate (a) change-detection/identity scalability from (b) downstream selective plan+rebuild scalability in a new protocol. Do not modify Protected Core after the final fresh-seed equivalence holdout merely to manufacture a speedup.
